_comment: Provenance pin for the mlx-lm upstream code vendored into cppmega_v4 Path E
and the V4 mHC / MTP stack. Each entry records the upstream PR, the path it
was copied from, whether it is a verbatim snapshot or a cppmega-authored
derivative, and a sha256 of the vendored file as committed. The drift check
recomputes these hashes and fails if a vendored file diverges from its
recorded snapshot, so silent edits to a 'verbatim' copy cannot slip in.
Hashes are over the file bytes exactly as stored in the repo.

entries.used_by: GDN/KDA Path E (gated_delta_update, gated_delta_kernel, gated_delta_ops, compute_g)
entries.notes: Snapshot includes the PR #1066 Kahan-compensated kv_mem accumulation + 4-way time-loop unroll; this is NOT identical to an older mlx-lm checkout that predates PR #1066.

entries.used_by: Lightning Indexer FP8 (pure-MLX, NOT Path E) + MoE FP8 loaders
entries.notes: Inline upstream snippet pulled into a standalone dequant_block_fp8 utility; functionally faithful but reorganised, hence 'derived'.

entries.used_by: GDN Path E training backward (fused Metal VJP)
entries.notes: cppmega-authored fused Metal VJP built on the vendored PR #1217 gated_delta_kernel; upstream has no registered VJP.

entries.used_by: GDN Path E training backward (gradient-checkpointed Python reference)
entries.notes: cppmega-authored chunked Python VJP wrapping the vendored PR #1217 ops; bounds T>=2048 memory.
